title: All the art in my game made with chatgpt and stable diffusion. Let me know your thoughts!
author: Glittering-Chef-4914

comments.author: Glittering-Chef-4914
comments.body:
Finally have an announcement trailer made. The demo is coming out next week on steam in preparation for Next Fest.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882680/Auto\_Jurassic\_Knights/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882680/Auto_Jurassic_Knights/)

I'd love to hear any feedback or answer any questions!

comments.author: GamePink
comments.body: Animations and FX could use some work, but overall looks very consistent!

replies.author: Independent-Fun815
replies.body: Yep. The animations are lifeless. The characters don't portray any emotion and thus make the overall vibe very mid. It looks like a darkest dungeon copy but much worse. A confusing art direction. An asset flip vibe.

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body:
Pros: visual consistency, good effort, interesting theme

Cons: Generic designs (could use a human touch, more creativity, better designs), maybe too much visual consistency, could use some spots which depart from the analogous color scheme, Ani.ations could be more dynamic
